name: priest
description: a Priest (Fall from Heaven), an old man with a grey beard and grey hair, a tall white-and-gold bishop's mitre with gold crosses, long white vestments with broad gold trim and gold crosses, a gold stole, brown shoes, and a tall gold sceptre-staff topped with a spiked gold sun held upright in his LEFT hand (screen-right); his RIGHT hand (screen-left) rests against his chest
hands: the sun-topped gold staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty hand held against his chest on the screen-left side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (his empty right hand jerks off his chest with the elbow flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown out to the right holding the sun-topped gold staff upright), the tall mitre tilting back
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the sun-topped staff tilting out to the right, his empty right hand still raised in front of his chest, elbow out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up holding the sun-topped staff high, his empty right hand clutched to his chest
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the sun-topped staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the staff tilted down to the right with its gold sun resting on the ground, his empty right hand still held against his chest
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the sun-topped staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the white vestments flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the tall mitre still on his head; the sun-topped gold staff lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the white vestments settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the sun-topped gold staff on the ground beside him
